prior_exposure: Prior same-civil-bin #245/246 winner claims, detector-q alias #247-252, distance radius #253, and q/w variance #255 were seen before this distinct study. Do not treat new outcome as blind empirical confirmation.
question: Which comparisons among frozen trained clock, astronomical solar-noon, sunrise/sunset solar-phase, average-anchor, and branch-dependent season models survive a common bounded detector sensitivity q in each of the SAME civil-clock 96 observation bins?

data_frame.model_provenance: Reuse odsp.uljin_common_clock_mechanistic_comparison_v0 precompute_profiles and _fit_and_score, existing 48 half-hour candidate peak grid, original five fixed families; do not retrain when changing q envelope.

physical_detector_model.external_target_near_fraction_bound: Each clock-bin q_effective = qfar+(qnear-qfar)*w, with w in [0.5-delta,0.5+delta] for each day and civil-bin (or each 4h block), shared among all heldout sites on the same day and all competing model families. This bound is HYPOTHETICAL, not derived from two-bin q/w calibration.
physical_detector_model.q_bounds: q_low=0.6-0.6delta; q_high=0.6+0.6delta for each 15min civil bin. Detector q assumed piecewise constant inside each original civil bin and camera operation frame.

two_external_constraint_classes.definition: q_k can vary independently over each day×96 original civil-clock bins
q_k shared for each six frozen 4-hour CIVIL blocks of sixteen 15-min bins within each day, but may vary between dates; same q across every model

mathematics.conditional_multinomial_common_response: For a site/date, candidate fixed base predicted civil-bin masses m_{family,date,k} already integrate model-coordinate density, Jacobian and known camera operating hours. With shared detector q_{date,k}, predicted conditional probability is p_m,k(q)=m_m,k*q_k / sum_l(m_m,l*q_l).
mathematics.same_q_requirement: All candidates get exactly the SAME unknown q on the same original day and original event bins; never optimize q independently per candidate.
mathematics.pairwise_logscore_difference: sum_{s,d,k} site_equal_weight y_s,d,k*log(m_A,d,k/m_B,d,k) - sum_{s,d} site_equal_weight N_s,d*log[Z_A,d(q)/Z_B,d(q)], with site_equal_weight=1/(16*total_site_events) and Z_m=sum_k m_m,k*q_k.
mathematics.sharp_extrema: For positive masses a_k,b_k, q group g lower<=q_g<=upper, extrema of (sum_g A_g q_g)/(sum_g B_g q_g) are attained at group endpoint vertices. Solve fractional-linear roots via signed-coefficient extrema and 65 deterministic bisections; optimize common q not two independent denominators.
mathematics.aggregate_day_separability: Assume detector q independent across dates but COMMON for all 16 heldout sites on that date; add exact best/worst date-specific normalizer contributions. This is a conservative conditional SENSITIVITY interval, not a confidence interval.
mathematics.reported: Sharp min/max heldout EQUAL PHYSICAL SITE logscore difference nats/detected-event for each pair; fixed nominal-q heldout score difference; sign robustness only if entire interval >0 or <0. Model training remains at q=constant; no robust refit of training.
